svg.title: C2 soft dimensional style sheet
svg.text: Character art style sheet for LangQuest — warm key light upper-left, cool rim lower-right, no outlines, three value steps per material.
6–9 px stroke clipped to the shape (half visible)
under every object that rests on another
Rule: 0 px outline. Touching materials separate by value (25+ L* steps). Facial features are soft
2–3.6 px rounded strokes in a darker skin tone. A 1.5 px line in the shadow colour at 20–35 % is
allowed only where two same-value shapes touch (chin on neck, hair on hair).
Rounded, slightly inflated forms, big soft heads
Three stops per gradient, one rim, one specular
Expression = brows + mouth + head tilt, never colour
Contemporary clothing, one accent colour each
Hair / skin / clothes / disc = four distinct values
Black or dark outlines, cel-shaded hard shadows
Photo textures, noise, bevel or drop-shadow filters
Two light directions or a coloured key light
Baked-in text, logos, flags, costumes, landmarks
Features under 2 px at 24 px (thin lashes, chains)
Lips: darker skin tone or soft rose
96 px colour · 48 / 24 / 16 px grayscale (feColorMatrix, check only).
Pass: bun / glasses / wavy hair silhouettes and the smile still read at 24 px.
Dark mode: swap disc ramp for a deep tone, raise rim to 80 %, keep skin ramps.
System fonts only. This sheet is documentation, not a product asset. All artwork is original; no CC0 decorations were used in this exploration.
